info.title: Addis Eats API
info.description:
Food delivery for Addis Ababa.

**Money is in santim, not birr.** 24000 santim is 240.00 ETB. Prices and totals are always whole numbers.
**Phone numbers are TeleBirr numbers:** `09xxxxxxxx` or `+2519xxxxxxxx`.

**Orders are priced by the server.** You send the lines (a dish and a quantity); the total is computed from the menu. Sending a `totalSantim` is rejected.

**Every error has the same five fields:** `statusCode`, `message`, `path`, `timestamp`, `requestId`. Quote the `x-request-id` response header (it is the same id) when you report a problem.
A request that takes longer than 5 seconds answers **408**, and an unexpected failure answers **500** with a generic message.

**Authentication:** register with `POST /auth/register`, log in with `POST /auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the access token. Browsing restaurants, dishes and delivery fees is open. Everything else needs a token, and changing or cancelling an order needs the staff role.

tags.name: delivery-fees
tags.description: What delivery costs in each area

email.description: The account email. Letter case does not matter: it is stored in lower case.

password.description: 10 to 128 characters. The upper limit stops a huge password being hashed on purpose.

message.description: What went wrong. An array of strings for validation, one per broken rule, each naming its field.

requestId.description: The request id: the same value as the x-request-id response header.

email.description: The email the account was registered with.

accessToken.description: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request. Short-lived.

refreshToken.description: Send it ONLY to POST /auth/refresh, when the access token has expired. It works once.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token from the last login or refresh. It works once: every refresh issues a new one.

customerId.description: The user who placed the order.

courierId.description: The courier user the order is assigned to.

dishes.description: One entry per unit ordered: two lines of Doro Wat appear twice.

telebirrPhone.description: The TeleBirr number the customer gave, if any.

totalSantim.description: Whole santim, computed by the server from the dishes. 64000 is 640.00 ETB.

dishId.description: A dish id. The dish must be on the menu of the restaurant being ordered from.

customer.description: The customer's full name, as they gave it.

area.description: One of the four Addis Ababa delivery areas.

restaurantId.description: The restaurant to order from. It must exist (404) and be open (409).

paymentMethod.description: How the customer pays. TELEBIRR requires a phone number. Defaults to CASH.

phone.description: TeleBirr number: `09xxxxxxxx` or `+2519xxxxxxxx`. Required when paymentMethod is TELEBIRR.

lines.description: What is being ordered: at least one line. The total is computed from these, never sent.

status.description: The status to move to. Only legal moves are accepted, anything else is a 409.

area.description: The area in its canonical spelling, whatever letter case was sent.

isOpen.description: Closed restaurants still appear in lists. Check this before offering a menu: placing an order with a closed restaurant answers 409.

area.description: The area the restaurant is in.

isOpen.description: Whether it is taking orders right now. Defaults to true.

restaurantId.description: The restaurant whose menu this dish is on.

name.description: The dish's name as it appears on the menu.

priceSantim.description: The price in whole santim, 1 to 10,000,000. 15000 is 150.00 ETB.

restaurantId.description: The restaurant whose menu gets this dish. It must exist (404).
